B. Srinivasan

Managing Director  |  MV Switchgear Specialist & Innovator

B.Sc (Electronics) & MBA (International Business)  ·  Age 58  ·  25+ years in industry

Executive profile

Executive and technological leader with expertise across research and development, detailed engineering, prototype manufacturing, type testing, production, installation and commissioning of medium voltage switchgear (AIS & GIS) from 3.3 kV to 40.5 kV. Has headed a medium voltage switchgear manufacturing enterprise in Salem, Tamil Nadu for over 11 years, working on innovation, industrial safety and distribution automation.

Technical expertise & switchgear solutions

  • Medium voltage switchgear (3.3 kV – 40.5 kV): AIS & GIS vacuum circuit breakers, load break switches, off-load isolators and earth switches.
  • Advanced technology & actuators: permanent magnetic actuator operated vacuum circuit breakers, auto reclosers, sectionalisers and special VCBs for capacitor switching.
  • Ring main units & interrupters: SF6 insulated ring main units, air insulated ring main units and vacuum interrupters.
  • Protection & heavy duty breakers: control and relay panels, metal-clad indoor/outdoor VCB switchboards, high voltage motor starters, vacuum contactors, generator circuit breakers and traction breakers (single pole and double pole / loco breakers).
  • Testing & quality assurance: hands-on experience in type testing and international compliance across all MV vacuum switchgear categories.

Leadership & key achievements

  • Managing Director (11+ years) of a medium voltage switchgear manufacturing business based in Salem, Tamil Nadu.
  • Patents & innovations: 7 patents filed, covering distribution automation and electrical safety.

Education & credentials

Academic qualifications
  • B.Sc. in Electronics
  • MBA in International Business
Patents & intellectual property
  • 7 patents filed in distribution automation and electrical safety
